All 27 DPS specs requested fresh this run (talent_target_scaling / castingpatchwerk), up to 3 attempts each with backoff. 24 charts returned and the SAME persistent three returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on every retry — Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker — which is the identical set SimulationCraft is also missing, corroborating that the absence is upstream rather than transport. simc_settings.ptr compared explicitly against the STRING "0"; simc_settings.tier read off each chart (never hard-coded) and all 24 read MID2, so the stored pool stays tier-uniform at 24 and no mixed-tier merge was attempted. Target map read as data[<tier>][<targetCount>], which is already best-build — an earlier pass in this session treated that level as a per-build object, got 24 empty target maps and would have looked exactly like an outage; it was caught by the pre-merge diff and corrected before any merge. Merged at counts 1/2/3/5/8/15 with asOf = each CHART's own timestamp (2026-09-10 for Feral Druid, 2026-09-09 for the other 23), never the run date. Result: 0 target-value moves, 0 tier changes, 0 profiles gained or lost — byte-identical for a fifth consecutive run. The coverage date is therefore the data's own 2026-09-09, 6 days old against maxAgeDays 5, so this row is partial and the heartbeat red is the honest signal that upstream has not re-simmed.

MID2_Raid.txt fetched fresh this run, HTTP 200, 1,439,514 bytes, and it HAS a "DPS Ranking:" block, so the plain-text lane sufficed and the multi-MB HTML report was not needed. Header era-verified off the build string, not the visible version: "SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69814 Live (hotfix 2026-09-12/69814, git build HEAD ac0f3a3c7f, no-networking)". THE GIT HASH MOVED — ac0f3a3c7f against f8352efc00 on the 09-14 run at the same build 69814 — so this is a genuine re-sim and not a re-read, and the values move accordingly. MID1_Raid was not read: it has been a 272-byte in-progress stub carrying the same build header since 2026-09-01 and is not a fallback. 45 ranking entries, the Raid aggregate row skipped, mapped by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed (MID2_Demon_Hunter_Devourer_Void-Scarred and MID2_Death_Knight_Frost_Rider both resolve correctly) -> 24 DPS specs, best hero-variant per spec. The 7 unmapped entries are all tanks, excluded by role as designed; Balance, Augmentation and Devastation remain absent upstream. 23 of 24 values moved and every move is sim noise: largest is Outlaw Rogue -0.10% (256,878 -> 256,620), and Marksmanship/Survival/Elemental moved under 0.01% — nowhere near maxValueMovePct 0.6, so no value_move_ack is implicated. asOf = the report's own hotfix date 2026-09-12, unchanged, 3 days old against maxAgeDays 10 but outside the 1-day success window, so the row is partial.
